description: This file provides a safe API for operating on /proc on Linux, including functions for opening, reading links, and managing process-specific paths within /proc.

classes.name: ProcBase
classes.description: Represents a base path within /proc for path operations.

classes.name: Handle
classes.description: Wrapper around an *os.File handle to /proc, used for safe procfs operations.

methods.name: ProcPid
methods.description: Returns a ProcBase for a specific PID or TID, with safety considerations regarding PID recycling.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the Handle.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Creates a new Handle to a safe /proc directory with configurable options.

methods.name: fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor associated with the Handle.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Internal method to open a path relative to a ProcBase, locking the thread if necessary.

methods.name: OpenRoot
methods.description: Opens a path from inside /proc, used for global info or other processes.

methods.name: OpenSelf
methods.description: Opens a path from inside /proc/self, for current process info.

methods.name: OpenPid
methods.description: Opens a path from inside /proc/$pid, where pid can be a PID or TID.

methods.name: OpenThreadSelf
methods.description: Opens a path from inside /proc/thread-self, locking the thread for thread-specific info.

methods.name: Readlink
methods.description: Reads the target of a symlink from the given procfs base.
